rationale: The assistant immediately recognised the water-near-socket hazard, told her not to touch the plug or machine and directed her to isolate at the consumer unit from the dry hall, then only investigated once power was off and correctly reached the torn door seal cut by the underwire. The door seal part was recommended appropriately, with an explicit request to find the Beko model number first and an engineer option. Weaknesses: it never told her to turn off the water supply, never followed up on whether the wet socket needs an electrician's check after confirming the floor under the plug was wet (only a generic mention in the first message), and the final 'Before you start, switch it off and unplug it' is redundant boilerplate given power was already isolated.
